name: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization
definition: Initializes a set of 3D Gaussians from COLMAP point cloud data (xyz, rgb) by creating learnable parameters for position, features, scaling, rotation, and opacity.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization converts raw geometric data into valid, differentiable 3D Gaussian parameters for training, focusing exclusively on initial creation rather than dynamic modification.
